Maya (Eng-Platform): quick follow-up from the RCA for INC-234 — we need to confirm owners + realistic due dates so we can close the postmortem. I sketched a suggested rollforward plan below, please ack and edit dates if you need more time.

Maya (Eng-Platform): ```
Action | Owner | Proposed due
1) add dashboard alert + retention review | Ryan (Eng-SRE) | 2026-03-17
2) model fallback policy & testing harness | Jess (Eng-ML) | 2026-03-19
3) GPU pool autoscale params + quota request | Tom (Eng-Infra) | 2026-03-18
4) customer comms + support playbook | Priya (Product) | 2026-03-16
5) tie SLO links into runbook + RCA doc updates | Maya (Eng-Platform) | 2026-03-17
```

Ryan (Eng-SRE): ack. I can own #1 but need the quota bump finished first (drafted ticket infra#4521). Can we move #1 to 2026-03-18 if quota takes time? Also adding `monitoring/alerts` PR: https://git.company/alerts/pull/124 :thumbsup:

Jess (Eng-ML): ack for #2. I need a small evaluation harness to validate fallback quality. ETA for harness: 2 days after infra change is live. If quota + autoscale are delayed, bump to 2026-03-20. Will post eval plan later today.

Tom (Eng-Infra): noted. quota change is scheduled but we have a deploy freeze until 2026-03-17 17:00 UTC (ops announcement). I can file the autoscale PR but won't merge until freeze lifts, so realistic target for #3 is 2026-03-19. filing infra PR now: https://git.company/infra/pull/987

Priya (Product): I can draft the customer message and support playbook by 2026-03-16 morning. Will ping legal for the template. If we want a more cautious tone, ask me before EOD today.

Maya (Eng-Platform): thanks all. Updated proposed dates: #1 -> 2026-03-18 (Ryan), #2 -> 2026-03-20 (Jess if blocked), #3 -> 2026-03-19 (Tom), #4 stays 2026-03-16 (Priya), #5 -> I'll finish 2026-03-17 AM.

Maya (Eng-Platform): small ask — please paste PR/ticket links in the RCA doc under the Actions section once you open them. I will set the RCA status to "in progress - assigned" after I see links.

Ryan (Eng-SRE): added infra#4521 + alerts PR to RCA doc. One question: who owns verification of the alert (pager test)? I can trigger smoke runs but prefer eng-platform to own the post-deploy runbook step.

Maya (Eng-Platform): I will own the post-deploy verification checklist and add it to the RCA runbook. Thanks.

infra-bot: Deploy freeze in effect until 2026-03-17 17:00 UTC. See #ops for exceptions.

Tom (Eng-Infra): flagged exception for the quota change (ops approved). Will sequence PR merge right after freeze.

Jess (Eng-ML): posting eval plan now: will run fallbacks on 10 sample sessions + compare perplexity/diff. If results look good, fallback metric + monitoring added to runbook.

Priya (Product): draft for customer comms posted in docs: https://docs.company/comms/inc-234-draft. Feedback welcome.

Maya (Eng-Platform): closing checklist: if everyone acks these new dates and has added links by EOD 2026-03-17, I'll mark actions as assigned and move RCA to "tracking". If any owner can't meet the date, please state it here with a new ETA.

Ryan (Eng-SRE): ack 2026-03-18 for #1 (owns).

Jess (Eng-ML): ack 2026-03-20 if autoscale delayed; will try for 2026-03-19 if infra completes earlier.

Tom (Eng-Infra): ack 2026-03-19 for #3.

Priya (Product): ack 2026-03-16 for #4 — will share final by noon.

Maya (Eng-Platform): thanks. I'll check in after the freeze. :white_check_mark:
